scenarios.title: Time travel adds or removes a time counter on a chosen permanent that has one

A: All of History, All at Once

setup.notes: Calciderm (5/5 shroud, vanishing 4) is on the battlefield with one time counter.

decisions: A casts All of History, All at Once, tapping four Islands; Storm triggers but no spell was cast before it, so there are no copies.
Both players pass; the spell resolves and A time travels.
A chooses Calciderm and chooses to add a time counter.

variants.label: add
variants.expected: Calciderm has 2 time counters and stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: remove
variants.delta: A chooses to remove a time counter instead of adding one.
variants.expected: Calciderm has 0 time counters; vanishing's trigger sacrifices it, and Calciderm is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: choose_nothing
variants.delta: A chooses no permanent to time travel.
variants.expected: Calciderm still has 1 time counter and stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: opponents_permanent
variants.delta: Calciderm is on B's battlefield instead of A's, with the same one time counter; A has no permanent to choose.
variants.expected: Calciderm still has 1 time counter on B's battlefield; time travel affects only permanents the caster controls.

cards: All of History, All at Once
scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's TimeTravelEffect offers the caster's exiled cards that have suspend and the caster's battlefield permanents with a time counter.

scenarios.title: Time travel adds or removes a time counter on a suspended card, and removing the last one lets it be cast

A: All of History, All at Once

setup.notes: Rift Bolt is suspended in exile with one time counter.

decisions: A casts All of History, All at Once, tapping four Islands; Storm triggers but no spell was cast before it, so there are no copies.
Both players pass; the spell resolves and A time travels.
A chooses the suspended Rift Bolt and chooses to remove a time counter.
The suspend trigger resolves; A casts Rift Bolt without paying its mana cost, targeting player B; Rift Bolt resolves.

variants.label: remove
variants.expected: The last time counter is removed from Rift Bolt, A casts it for free, and it deals 3 damage to B (B at 17). Rift Bolt is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: add
variants.delta: A chooses to add a time counter instead of removing one (and casts nothing).
variants.expected: Rift Bolt has 2 time counters and stays in exile; B stays at 20.

variants.label: choose_nothing
variants.delta: A chooses no card to time travel (and casts nothing).
variants.expected: Rift Bolt still has 1 time counter in exile; B stays at 20.

cards: All of History, All at Once
